content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"signed-in user","i_want":"to view my task list with a status indicator and a priority indicator on each task","so_that":"I can see the state and priority of every task I own at a glance","business_description":"The to-do management page shows the signed-in user's own tasks as a list. Each row shows the task title, its status (Open, In Progress or Completed) and its priority (Low, Medium or High). The list has distinct loading, empty and error states, and it refreshes after each successful task change.","business_value":"Users can see their workload and what needs attention without opening each task. Showing the list only from saved backend data avoids showing changes that were not saved.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"a signed-in user with at least one task","when":"the to-do management page task with status Open, a task with status In Progress and a task with status Completed in the user's list","when":"the task list view is displayed","then":"each task shows a status indicator that names its status exactly as Open, In Progress or Completed"},{"given":"a task with priority Low, a task with priority Medium and a task with priority High in the user's list","when":"the task list view is displayed","then":"each task shows a priority indicator that names its priority exactly as Low, Medium or High"},{"given":"the backend read-all request for the user's tasks has not yet returned","when":"the task list view is opened","then":"a loading state is shown and no task rows and no empty message are shown"},{"given":"the backend read-all request returns zero tasks for the user","when":"the task list view is displayed","then":"an empty state is shown that is visibly different from the loading state and from the error state"},{"given":"the backend read-all request fails with an error response","when":"the task list view is displayed","then":"an error state is shown that is visibly different from the loading and empty states, and no previously loaded task rows are shown as current"},{"given":"the task list view is showing the user's tasks","when":"the user creates, edits, deletes or changes the status of a task and the backend confirms the change","then":"the
